attributes.title: 2027 CAPS Annual Conference
attributes.summary:
The Christian Association for Psychological Studies meets March 18 to 20, 2027, at the Omni Dallas Hotel. The program has pre- and post-conference workshops, more than 100 breakout sessions, poster sessions and special interest group meetings, with an opening gala and a plenary luncheon included in general registration.

Mark McMinn gives the Thursday evening plenary, "Bookends and Pathways: Grace in the Therapy Room". CAPS lists continuing education among the conference features, but the accrediting bodies and hour totals were not published yet when we checked.

Fees were not published on the conference page; pre- and post-conference workshops are registered and paid separately.
